text:
anya: Heads-up — target publish for customer announcement is Tue 09:00am PT. Need final changelog link, live docs URL, canary window, short benchmark hero line, and confirmation of partner embargo. @lucas @sam @mari

lucas: Draft changelog is here: https://redwood.in/changelog/v1.7.0-draft. I'll merge Mon 3pm PT if no blocker. Plan for canary: Mon 8pm PT start, 10% for 1h, health check 30m, then 50% for 1.5h before final flip Tue 08:30am PT.

sam: Docs will publish Mon 7:45pm PT to https://docs.redwood.in/release/v1.7.0. I'll put a "Quick highlights" 1-paragraph and the API snippet. Marketing please give the 1-line headline and the social copy.

mari: Short benchmark blurb for blog: "~17% median token latency reduction on 12k-context runs; up to 2x sustained throughput under bursty load." For social keep it simple: "Faster inference for long-context apps."

anya: Good. Sales requests that blog CTAs include tracking so trial signups route to Dedicated-interest queue. Can eng append UTMs before publish?

lucas: Yes, will add ?utm_source=blog&utm_campaign=v1_7_0 to changelog and docs links pre-publish. No legal hold. Partner embargo: Tue 8:45am PT (15m before public).

sam: Docs link live (staging): https://docs.redwood.in/release/v1.7.0-staging 545 I'll swap to prod URL after changelog merge. Header text draft: "Smoothed latency for long-context models; improved batching and safer feature-flagged rollouts."

lucas: Ops note: new quant profiles behind ff_quant_v1_7. Runbook snippet below for the release doc:```bash
# start canary
redwoodctl rollout start --release=v1.7.0 --canary=10 --monitor=30m
# if unhealthy
redwoodctl rollout rollback --release=v1.7.0
# feature flag toggle in canary only
redwoodctl feature toggle ff_quant_v1_7 --on --env=canary
```

devops-bot: Canary scheduled: Mon 2024-06-17T20:00:00-07:00. Notifying #eng-oncall and #release-health.

anya: Marketing to finalize blog + social by Mon 5pm PT. Also planning a short webinar Tue 11:00am PT; need a 2-slide benchmark + demo deck. Can someone from eng confirm a presenter?

mari: I can present the benchmark slide and walk through the test harness. Will drop a one-slide PDF by Mon 4pm PT. Also will paste the canary health channel link when rollout starts.

sam: I'll make sure the docs include the CTA with the UTM and a small FAQ about quantization profiles.

lucas: I'll post final changelog URL and the prod docs URL here once merged. Also will post the canary health checks to #release-health at start.

anya: Quick messaging request: blog hero should emphasize customer impact not numbers. Use Mari's detailed numbers in the blog body and the webinar slide. Social lead: "Faster and steadier inference for long-context LLMs."

mari: Sounds good. I'll annotate slide with brief methods note: test harness, dataset mix, and steady-state runs at 95th perc.

devops-bot: Canary started. Monitoring channels: #release-health, #eng-oncall.

anya: Thanks team 545 action items: Lucas 545 merge + UTMs; Sam 545 publish docs prod URL + CTA; Mari 545 slide + canary monitors; Marketing 545 finalize copy and schedule Tue 09:00am PT. I'll post a preflight checklist Mon 7pm PT. :rocket:
